---
title: "Reflection on the use of GenAI"
---

In this assessment, I used Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT to help me understand the tasks and instructions more clearly.

I chose this tool because it provides simple explanations and step-by-step guidance, which was useful when working with unfamiliar tools like Quarto. It helped me organise my content and complete the assessment more efficiently.

Overall, GenAI was beneficial in reducing confusion and improving my learning experience. In the future, I believe such tools can continue to support my studies by assisting with learning and problem-solving, while still requiring my own understanding and effort.
